notes.title: Ver.1.2.1
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where the seagull had no hitbox.
Fixed the issue where the hawk would suddenly disappear.
Fixed the issue where the achievement for clearing stage 20 would not unlock if the game was completed without saving once.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug where, after setting the language during the initial launch, the game would start with 0 coins and lead to a game over.
